records.title: Action safety and authority
records.owner: Forseti, Var, Thor, Saga, and Vidar
question_aliases: How does FDAI keep actions safe?
FDAI는 작업을 어떻게 안전하게 실행하나요?
designed_behavior: Every action is a typed ActionType with risk, approval, rollback, impact, and audit boundaries.
Natural language can propose work but never grants execution authority.
implemented_behavior: The action ontology and separated judge, approver, executor, auditor, and recovery roles are present.
limitations: A capability is not production-authorized merely because its ActionType and code exist.

records.title: Saga hash-chained audit ledger and DSSE pack verification
question_aliases: How does FDAI prevent audit log tampering and verify DSSE remediation packs?
감사 로그 위변조 방지와 Saga 해시 체인 및 DSSE 서명 검증은 어떻게 동작하나요?
designed_behavior: Saga chains every audit entry to its predecessor SHA-256 digest and recovers canonical audit windows by committed head-hash ancestry rather than sequence-only selection.
Code-security remediation packs are signed with Ed25519 DSSE envelopes and checked against the revocation registry before export.
implemented_behavior: read_audit_chain_window, read_audit_chain_entries, and DSSE build_envelope / verify_envelope are implemented.
limitations: Audit verification and DSSE signature checks are read-only integrity guarantees with execution_authority=false.

records.title: Structured behavior knowledge
question_aliases: How does FDAI explain its own behavior?
FDAI는 자신의 동작을 어떻게 설명하나요?
designed_behavior: BehaviorSpec separates answerable behavior from source metadata used for freshness and authority checks.
Implemented evidence outranks designed-only evidence, while stale or conflicting records are held.
implemented_behavior: The provider contracts, 13 reference seeds, OperatorBehaviorKnowledgeResolver, and PostgresBehaviorKnowledgeIndex are implemented.
limitations: Reference citations describe repository contracts and are never treated as live tenant observations.

records.title: Bragi conversation boundary
question_aliases: What is Bragi responsible for?
Bragi는 무엇을 담당하나요?
designed_behavior: Bragi routes questions and presents typed results but never judges, approves, or executes.
implemented_behavior: The Pantheon specification binds Bragi to Conversation, Turn, preferences, and review projections.
limitations: Bragi ownership does not make every conversational capability production-validated.

records.title: Code Security Review and verification packs
question_aliases: How does FDAI Code Security Review work?
FDAI 코드 보안 검토는 어떻게 동작하나요?
designed_behavior: SARIF findings from deterministic, LLM-lens, and external scanners collapse into canonical issues with P0-P4 priorities and Ed25519-signed remediation packs.
Operator projections on /code-security expose bounded triage counts and opaque issue IDs without leaking source code or scanner prose.
implemented_behavior: Review signal validation, Heimdall drift publication, pack signing, and Operator /code-security projections are implemented.
limitations: Code security scan projections never auto-merge code or grant execution authority.

records.title: FDAI Console web security boundary
question_aliases: Is the FDAI Console web application secure?
FDAI 콘솔웹이 보안상 문제가 없나?
designed_behavior: The Console SPA holds zero cloud or executor credentials, enforces Entra ID with server-verified GET /iam/self RBAC, and keeps all views read-only (execution_authority=false).
Guidance assets are SHA-256 digest-verified, arbitrary HTML/SVG/JS execution is forbidden, and state changes require the 5-role ActionType pipeline with 7 safeguards.
implemented_behavior: OperatorAuthenticator, RBAC projections, digest-pinned framework guidance, and /code-security plus /rules posture views are implemented.
limitations: Architectural SPA isolation does not substitute for live tenant TLS, network, or IAM verification in a deployed environment.

records.title: Governed document ingestion
records.owner: Document Ingestion API and Document Processing Worker
question_aliases: How does FDAI ingest documents?
FDAI는 문서를 어떻게 수집하나요?
designed_behavior: Uploads enter quarantine, safety and protection checks, extraction, chunking, indexing, and access-filtered retrieval.
Derived content inherits source access, classification, version, and retention policy.
implemented_behavior: The repository ships independent ingestion and processing distributions with local and Azure provider seams.
limitations: Production provider binding and measured scale evidence remain deployment-owned.

records.title: Durable conversation delivery
question_aliases: How does FDAI prevent duplicate chat replies?
FDAI는 중복 채팅 응답을 어떻게 방지하나요?
designed_behavior: Conversation requests persist before publication and replies persist before provider I/O.
Ambiguous acknowledgement is terminal duplicate risk and is not retried automatically.
implemented_behavior: Stable delivery identity, claims, acknowledgements, breakers, and restart recovery are implemented.
limitations: Each provider still requires an exact deployed canary before it is considered validated.

records.title: FDAI accuracy contract
question_aliases: What accuracy does FDAI guarantee?
FDAI는 어떤 정확성을 보장하나요?
designed_behavior: FDAI guarantees contract-conformant behavior, not a correct diagnosis for every novel case.
Insufficient evidence produces an explicit unknown, no-op, denial, rollback, or human review outcome.
implemented_behavior: Traceability records link constitutional requirements to implementation and evidence.
limitations: Partial or planned traceability entries block a claim of complete runtime conformance.

records.title: Human identity and RBAC
question_aliases: How does FDAI authenticate and authorize people?
FDAI는 사용자를 어떻게 인증하고 권한을 확인하나요?
designed_behavior: Entra identity, FDAI roles, agent ownership, approval identity, and executor identity remain separate axes.
implemented_behavior: Conversation relationship context, approval callback identity, local session resilience, and IAM projections are implemented.
limitations: A role, stewardship assignment, or bot service token never grants executor authority.

records.title: Entra ID JWT verification and five-role RBAC boundary
question_aliases: How does FDAI enforce Entra ID authentication and RBAC JWT security?
FDAI에서 권한이나 RBAC, Entra ID 토큰 보안은 어떻게 검증하나요?
designed_behavior: Every Operator API route verifies Entra ID JWT issuer, audience, signature, and expiry and resolves group claims into Reader, Contributor, Approver, Owner, or BreakGlass.
GET /iam/self projects the server-verified role set with execution_authority=false; client-supplied role headers are rejected.
implemented_behavior: EntraJwtVerifier and OperatorFamilyAuthorizer enforce route-level role floors and fail closed on missing or expired credentials.
limitations: An Operator RBAC role never grants direct cloud-provider or executor credentials to the browser.

records.title: MSRC CSAF 2.0 vulnerability and AI security guardrails
question_aliases: How does FDAI govern MSRC CSAF vulnerabilities and AI prompt security?
MSRC CSAF 취약점 평가와 AI 보안 가드레일은 어떻게 동작하나요?
designed_behavior: MSRC CSAF 2.0 advisories and CISA KEV status are evaluated deterministically against resource version windows to assign P0-P3 remediation SLA tiers.

Untrusted prompts and documents are isolated from system instructions, checked by V-CLAIM and multi-model QualityGate consensus, and aligned with MCSB v2 AI-1..AI-7, OWASP LLM Top 10, and MITRE ATLAS.
implemented_behavior: MsrcCsafAssessmentRuntime, Heimdall CSAF drift projection, and QualityGate grounding verification are implemented.
limitations: Missing or stale resource version telemetry is reported as unknown rather than assumed patched.

records.title: Operating ontology
question_aliases: What does the FDAI ontology do?
FDAI 온톨로지는 어떤 역할을 하나요?
designed_behavior: The ontology validates shared object, relationship, evidence, action, and time meaning.
It constrains interpretation but does not observe, judge, approve, execute, or grant permission.
implemented_behavior: Exact releases, typed declarations, bounded object sets, and evidence lanes are implemented.
limitations: An ontology projection is not authoritative proof of current external state.

records.title: Fixed 15-agent Pantheon
question_aliases: How are FDAI agents organized?
FDAI agent 조직은 어떻게 구성되나요?
designed_behavior: Fifteen fixed agents divide observation, judgment, approval, execution, recovery, audit, and learning.
Authority-bearing collaboration uses schema-validated events and single-writer ownership.
implemented_behavior: The fixed roster, charters, topics, and role bindings are represented in PANTHEON_SPECS.
limitations: Agent presence does not imply that every enforcement capability is promoted.

records.title: Root-cause analysis
question_aliases: How does FDAI perform root cause analysis?
FDAI는 근본 원인 분석을 어떻게 수행하나요?
designed_behavior: RCA is a cited, bounded hypothesis that never grants approval or execution authority.
Conflicting, missing, stale, or scope-mismatched evidence produces a held result.
implemented_behavior: T0, T1, T2 hypothesis contracts, governed knowledge evidence, and read-only projection are implemented.
limitations: A retained live cohort has not yet proven governed operational cause accuracy across tiers.

records.title: Detection Rules and Framework Assessments governance
question_aliases: How are FDAI detection rules and framework assessments governed?
FDAI 규칙 화면과 WARA/WAF/CAF/MCSB 평가는 안전한가요?
designed_behavior: 52 active T0 Rego rules, 8,517 collected reference rules, and WARA, WAF, CAF, MCSB v1/v2, and MSRC CSAF 2.0 controls evaluate in shadow mode with execution_authority=false.
Rule activation generation pointer changes require distinct requester and approver principals.
implemented_behavior: Catalog projections, bidirectional MSRC CSAF CVE citations, illustrated 5-node diagrams, and catalog.search_rules retrieval are implemented.
limitations: Collected reference rules remain inert until promoted and activated through dual-principal governance.

records.title: Natural-language semantic routing
records.owner: Bragi and the Semantic Planning runtime
question_aliases: How does FDAI route natural-language questions?
FDAI는 자연어 질문을 어떻게 라우팅하나요?
designed_behavior: A schema-validated model proposes typed meaning and deterministic code validates and dispatches it.
Runtime keyword lists and regular expressions do not select conversational capabilities.
implemented_behavior: Semantic judgment, exact-release manifests, verified plans, and typed holds are implemented.
limitations: Model unavailability or insufficient confidence returns clarification or an unavailable result.

records.title: Independent service boundaries
question_aliases: How are FDAI services separated?
FDAI 서비스는 어떻게 분리되어 있나요?
designed_behavior: Each service owns its package, identity, data, migration, health, and rollback boundary.
A new split needs a forcing trigger and complete transport, durability, observability, cost, and rollback evidence.
implemented_behavior: Five service distributions have validated independent release evidence.
The System Knowledge Service is implemented as a sixth candidate without changing the validated five-service baseline.
limitations: The sixth service cannot claim production graduation until its scorecard and runtime receipts are complete.

records.title: Seven constitutional execution safeguards and risk gating
records.owner: Forseti, Var, Thor, Vidar, and Saga
question_aliases: What are FDAI's seven constitutional execution safeguards?
FDAI 자율 실행의 7대 안전장치와 위험 등급 관문은 무엇인가요?
designed_behavior: State-changing actions require all seven safeguards: stop condition, tested rollback, blast-radius limit, dry-run success, logical-target lock, idempotency key, and two-phase audit.
Actions are classified into A1-A4 risk tiers where A4 is denied and new capabilities start in shadow mode.
implemented_behavior: ShadowExecutor and _missing_safety_invariant enforce durable pre-dispatch audit intent, idempotency deduplication, and safeguard completeness before publication.
limitations: Natural-language utterances and Console UI interactions never grant execution authority.

records.title: System Knowledge Service
question_aliases: How does the FDAI system knowledge bot work?
FDAI 시스템 지식 봇은 어떻게 동작하나요?
designed_behavior: A dedicated Teams bot verifies direct mentions and searches a release-bound catalog in a separate process.
The service exposes no operational provider, approval, or execution capability.
implemented_behavior: The independent package, 21-record catalog compiler, deterministic search, Bot Framework and Outgoing Webhook Teams boundaries, Managed Identity Blob CAS claim ledger, incremental cost estimator, and <15m disable/restore rehearsal are implemented.
limitations: Production Teams registration, persistent-volume binding, scale evidence, and timed rollback remain open.

records.title: Teams operational conversation edge
question_aliases: How does the existing FDAI Teams conversation path work?
기존 FDAI Teams 대화 경로는 어떻게 동작하나요?
designed_behavior: The A3 edge authenticates Teams activities, maps vendor identity to an FDAI principal, and submits typed semantic turns.
Durable delivery persists the terminal answer before provider I/O.
implemented_behavior: Teams ingress, publisher, renderer, queue, composition, and delivery worker are implemented.
limitations: The Teams provider path has not retained the deployed validation receipt recorded for Slack.
The System Knowledge Service uses a separate bot and does not modify this operational path.
